jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a battered steel jerry can, plain olive-drab paint chipped to bare metal at the edges, its three handles on top, unprinted, no lettering, no stencil, no number on it. The object alone and cut out, centred and filling the frame: no floor, wall, ground or sky around it, a single bold silhouette that still reads at a quarter of this size, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with painterly shading; no black outlines, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game icon. Muted cool northern palette, worn, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, no numbers, every label, clock face, page, note and packet plain and blank, a transparent background.
